_about: Site-wide glossary checked by build/check_terms.py. For each concept: 'en' = English trigger (regex, case-insensitive); per language the term that must appear in the same string when the English one mentions the concept. A list = any of these forms is fine. 'avoid' = old or drifted forms that must not appear anywhere. 'skip' = string keys where the term is left out on purpose (short label, pronoun), with a reason. Skip key format: '<lang or *>:<string key>:<concept>'. Japanese kanji-work glosses (words:*) explain the word without repeating it, so they are not checked.
